---

```{=html}
<script>
(function () {
  function applyFeatured() {
    // Accept either `feature` or `featured` in projects.yml.
    document
      .querySelectorAll('#listing-listing .quarto-grid-item')
      .forEach(function (gridItem) {
        var flag = gridItem.querySelector(
          '.card-other-values .feature, .card-other-values .featured'
        );
        var isFeatured =
          !!flag && (flag.textContent || '').trim().toLowerCase() === 'true';
        var colWrapper = gridItem.closest('[class*="g-col"]');
        gridItem.classList.toggle('card-featured', isFeatured);
        if (colWrapper) colWrapper.classList.toggle('g-col-featured', isFeatured);
      });
  }

  function slugify(text) {
    return (text || '')
      .trim()
      .toLowerCase()
      .replace(/[^a-z0-9]+/g, '-')
      .replace(/^-+|-+$/g, '');
  }

  function colorCategories() {
    // Card tags
    document
      .querySelectorAll('#listing-listing .listing-category')
      .forEach(function (el) {
        var slug = slugify(el.textContent);
        if (slug) el.classList.add('cat-colored', 'cat-' + slug);
      });

    // Sidebar category list (skip "All", which has an empty data-category)
    document
      .querySelectorAll('.quarto-listing-category .category')
      .forEach(function (el) {
        if (!el.getAttribute('data-category')) return;
        // Use only the leading text node so the "(count)" span is excluded.
        var name = el.firstChild ? el.firstChild.textContent : el.textContent;
        var slug = slugify(name);
        if (slug) el.classList.add('cat-colored', 'cat-' + slug);
      });
  }

  var REDUCED_MOTION = window.matchMedia('(prefers-reduced-motion: reduce)').matches;
  var CAN_HOVER = window.matchMedia('(hover: hover)').matches;

  // "(4)" -> "4": the chip styling supplies the enclosure.
  function tidyCounts() {
    document
      .querySelectorAll('.quarto-listing-category .quarto-category-count')
      .forEach(function (el) {
        el.textContent = el.textContent.replace(/[()]/g, '').trim();
      });
  }

  // Fade card images in once loaded (placeholder tint shows meanwhile).
  function fadeInImages() {
    document
      .querySelectorAll('#listing-listing .thumbnail-image')
      .forEach(function (img) {
        if (img.dataset.fadeBound) return;
        img.dataset.fadeBound = '1';
        img.classList.add('img-fade');
        var done = function () { img.classList.add('img-loaded'); };
        if (img.complete && img.naturalWidth) done();
        else {
          img.addEventListener('load', done);
          img.addEventListener('error', done); // never leave a broken img invisible
        }
      });
  }

  // Cards rise into view on first scroll; disabled for reduced motion.
  function animateOnScroll() {
    if (REDUCED_MOTION || !('IntersectionObserver' in window)) return;
    if (!animateOnScroll.io) {
      animateOnScroll.io = new IntersectionObserver(function (entries) {
        entries.forEach(function (e) {
          if (e.isIntersecting) {
            e.target.classList.add('in-view');
            animateOnScroll.io.unobserve(e.target);
          }
        });
      }, { threshold: 0.08 });
    }
    document
      .querySelectorAll('#listing-listing .list > [class*="g-col"]')
      .forEach(function (el) {
        if (el.dataset.animBound) return;
        el.dataset.animBound = '1';
        el.classList.add('scroll-anim');
        animateOnScroll.io.observe(el);
      });
  }

  // GIF thumbnails: draw a static poster frame on a canvas overlay and only
  // reveal the animating GIF while the card is hovered. Hover-capable
  // devices only — on touch, GIFs simply play as before.
  function gifHoverPause() {
    if (!CAN_HOVER) return;
    document
      .querySelectorAll('#listing-listing .quarto-grid-item')
      .forEach(function (card) {
        if (card.dataset.gifBound) return;
        card.dataset.gifBound = '1';
        var img = card.querySelector('.thumbnail-image');
        if (!img || !/\.gif(\?|$)/i.test(img.getAttribute('src') || '')) return;
        var setup = function () {
          if (!img.naturalWidth || card.querySelector('.gif-poster')) return;
          var holder = img.parentElement;
          holder.classList.add('gif-holder');
          var canvas = document.createElement('canvas');
          canvas.className = 'gif-poster';
          var w = (canvas.width = img.clientWidth || img.naturalWidth);
          var h = (canvas.height = img.clientHeight || img.naturalHeight);
          // object-fit: cover equivalent
          var s = Math.max(w / img.naturalWidth, h / img.naturalHeight);
          var dw = img.naturalWidth * s;
          var dh = img.naturalHeight * s;
          canvas.getContext('2d').drawImage(img, (w - dw) / 2, (h - dh) / 2, dw, dh);
          holder.appendChild(canvas);
          card.addEventListener('mouseenter', function () { canvas.style.opacity = '0'; });
          card.addEventListener('mouseleave', function () { canvas.style.opacity = '1'; });
        };
        if (img.complete && img.naturalWidth) setup();
        else img.addEventListener('load', setup);
      });
  }

  function apply() {
    applyFeatured();
    colorCategories();
    tidyCounts();
    fadeInImages();
    animateOnScroll();
    gifHoverPause();
  }

  function init() {
    apply();
    var listEl = document.querySelector('#listing-listing .list');
    if (listEl) {
      // List.js reorders/refilters nodes; re-apply so classes survive.
      new MutationObserver(apply).observe(listEl, { childList: true });
    }
  }

  if (document.readyState === 'loading') {
    document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', init);
  } else {
    init();
  }
})();
</script>
```
